rows.grounds: indeclinable indicating sequence after previous placements
locative indicating the bodily location of placement; compound of vāma and bāhu
dative recipient characterized as having sixteen parts as its essence; compound of tat, ṣoḍaśa, kalā, ātman

items.question: Which bodily location and sixteen-part essence receive the next ritual placement?
premises: The instruction follows earlier placements on other body parts.
The act prescribed is a ritual placement.
The specified location is the left arm.
The recipient is identified as having sixteen parts as its essence.
items.inference: The next ritual placement is to be made on the left arm for the being whose essence consists of sixteen parts.
uncertainties: The specific mantra or deity name associated with the sixteen-part essence is not stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: Then one should place it on the left arm for that one whose essence consists of sixteen parts.
